services.title: Deep House Cleaning
services.description:
Service Description

I provide a thorough top-to-bottom cleaning for your home that goes far beyond surface-level tidying. Every session follows a systematic checklist to ensure no corner is overlooked. I focus on kitchens, bathrooms, floors, and those hard-to-reach spots where dust and grime accumulate over time. Using only eco-friendly, non-toxic products, I bring all my own professional-grade equipment including HEPA-filter vacuums, microfiber cloths, steam cleaners, and specialized brushes. This means you don't need to prepare anything before I arrive—just relax and let me handle the hard work.

This service is ideal for seasonal refreshes, pre-guest preparations, or when you simply want a reset for your living space. I pay special attention to often-neglected areas: inside cabinets and drawers, behind appliances, baseboards, window sills, ceiling fans, and light fixtures. I also scrub tile grout, descale shower heads, and polish mirrors and glass surfaces until they sparkle. For kitchens, I degrease range hoods, clean inside the microwave and oven (where accessible), and sanitize countertops and sinks. Bathrooms receive a deep scrub including toilet interiors, shower doors, and vanities.

I work efficiently without rushing, ensuring a high standard that leaves your home feeling genuinely refreshed and healthier, with allergens and bacteria significantly reduced.

What's Included

  • Dusting of all surfaces including baseboards, ceiling fans, and blinds
  • Vacuuming and mopping of all floors (hardwood, tile, carpet)
  • Kitchen deep clean: appliances exterior, counters, backsplash, sink
  • Bathroom deep clean: shower, tub, toilet, vanity, mirrors
  • Window and glass cleaning from inside
  • Organization of clutter (light tidying)
  • Trash disposal and replacement of liners

Pricing & Duration

  • Studio/1-bedroom: ~3 hours, starting at $120
  • 2-3 bedroom home: ~4-5 hours, starting at $180
  • 4+ bedroom home: ~6-8 hours, starting at $250
  • Eco-friendly products included at no extra charge
  • Flexible scheduling available (weekends and evenings upon request)

services.title: Office Cleaning
services.description:
Service Description

I offer reliable, recurring cleaning services for offices and commercial spaces, designed to maintain a professional and healthy work environment. I work around your business hours—early mornings, evenings, or weekends—to minimize disruption to your operations. Every visit follows a detailed checklist customized to your space's layout and specific needs, from open-plan workstations to private offices, kitchens, and restrooms.

I focus on high-touch surfaces that see the most traffic and germs: doorknobs, light switches, elevator buttons, telephones, keyboards, and shared equipment. Desks are dusted and sanitized, floors are vacuumed or mopped depending on surface type, and trash and recycling are managed responsibly. I can also restock basic supplies like paper towels, toilet paper, and hand soap if you provide them.

I offer flexible frequency options—daily, weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly—tailored to your traffic volume and budget. My goal is to deliver consistent results so your team can focus on their work in a clean, inviting space that also makes a positive impression on clients and visitors.

What's Included

  • Dusting and sanitizing all workstations, desks, and surfaces
  • Vacuuming carpets and mopping hard floors
  • Sanitizing high-touch areas (doorknobs, switches, handles, keyboards)
  • Kitchen/breakroom cleaning including countertops, microwave, fridge exterior, and sink
  • Restroom cleaning and sanitization
  • Trash and recycling removal
  • Glass door and window cleaning (common areas)

Pricing & Duration

  • Small office (up to 5 desks): ~1.5 hours, starting at $80 per visit
  • Medium office (5-15 desks): ~2.5-3 hours, starting at $140 per visit
  • Large office (15+ desks): custom quote
  • Discounts available for weekly or bi-weekly contracts
  • Free initial walkthrough and quote

services.title: Move-in/Move-out Cleaning
services.description:
Service Description

Moving is stressful enough—let me handle the cleaning so you can focus on the transition. I provide a comprehensive deep clean tailored specifically for move-in or move-out scenarios, designed to meet the expectations of landlords, property managers, and new homeowners. Every surface is addressed with the goal of leaving the property in pristine, move-in-ready condition.

I go far beyond standard cleaning: inside cabinets, closets, and drawers are thoroughly wiped down; appliances like ovens, refrigerators, and dishwashers are deep-cleaned inside and out; floors are scrubbed and polished; walls, baseboards, and doors are washed to remove marks and scuffs. I also clean window tracks, sills, and blinds, and ensure bathroom tiles, grout, and fixtures look like new. By the time I'm done, the property will be spotless, helping you secure your full security deposit back or welcoming you to a fresh start.

I bring all necessary equipment and supplies, including heavy-duty degreasers, glass cleaners, and floor scrubbers. A walkthrough is included to ensure you're completely satisfied.

What's Included

  • Full kitchen: inside and outside of all cabinets, drawers, appliances (fridge, oven, microwave, dishwasher), counters, sink, and backsplash
  • Full bathrooms: shower, tub, toilet, vanity, mirrors, cabinets, and tile/grout
  • All rooms: walls, baseboards, doors, windowsills, blinds, and ceiling fans
  • Floor cleaning: vacuum, mop, or steam clean depending on surface
  • Closet and drawer interior wipe-down
  • Light switch plates, outlet covers, and hardware cleaned
  • Trash removal

Pricing & Duration

  • Studio/1-bedroom: ~4 hours, starting at $160
  • 2-bedroom: ~5-6 hours, starting at $220
  • 3-bedroom: ~6-8 hours, starting at $280
  • 4+ bedrooms: custom quote
  • Additional fee for appliance deep-cleaning (already included)
  • Same-day service available in some cases

services.title: Window Cleaning
services.description:
Service Description

I provide professional interior and exterior window cleaning that delivers streak-free, crystal-clear results. Using purified water, professional-grade squeegees, and lint-free microfiber cloths, I remove dirt, dust, pollen, smudges, and hard water stains without leaving residues that attract future grime. I also clean window sills, tracks, and screens as part of the service to give you a complete, polished look.

I handle ground-floor windows and accessible second-story windows safely using extension tools; for higher floors or more complex access, I can use ladders or work with you to arrange safe access. All work is done with attention to protecting your home—I lay drop cloths and use drip-free tools to prevent water from damaging floors or walls.

Clean windows can transform the feel of your home, letting in more natural light and improving your view. I also offer add-on services like screen repair or replacement and track deep-cleaning upon request.

What's Included

  • Interior glass cleaning
  • Exterior glass cleaning (ground and accessible second floor)
  • Window sill and ledge cleaning
  • Window track vacuuming and wipe-down
  • Screen cleaning (removed and rinsed)
  • Removal of hard water spots and mineral deposits
  • All tools and cleaning solutions included

Pricing & Duration

  • Small home (up to 10 windows): ~2 hours, starting at $100
  • Medium home (10-20 windows): ~3-4 hours, starting at $180
  • Large home (20+ windows): custom quote
  • Commercial/office buildings: custom quote
  • Add-on: screen replacement (materials extra)

services.title: Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning
services.description:
Service Description

I offer deep steam or dry cleaning for carpets, rugs, and upholstered furniture to remove embedded dirt, pet stains, allergens, and odors that regular vacuuming leaves behind. Using hot water extraction (steam cleaning) or low-moisture dry cleaning depending on your fiber type, I lift dirt from deep within the pile and restore your fabrics to a fresh, like-new condition.

My process begins with a thorough vacuuming to remove loose debris, followed by pre-treatment of high-traffic areas and stubborn stains. I then apply a safe, biodegradable cleaning solution and use a powerful extraction machine to remove dirt and moisture. For delicate or wool rugs, I use specialized low-moisture methods to prevent shrinkage. After cleaning, I apply a deodorizer and, optionally, a fabric protector (Scotchgard) to help repel future stains and prolong freshness. Carpets typically dry within 6-12 hours with proper ventilation—I position fans to speed up the process.

I'm insured and experienced with all common carpet types: nylon, polyester, olefin, wool, and blends. Upholstery includes sofas, armchairs, dining chairs, and mattresses. I can even clean pet beds on request.

What's Included

  • Deep vacuuming of the entire area
  • Pre-treatment of stains and high-traffic areas
  • Hot water extraction or dry-cleaning application
  • Deodorizing treatment
  • Optional fabric protector application
  • Spot-check and touch-ups on stubborn stains
  • Furniture moved slightly to clean underneath (with your permission)

Pricing & Duration

  • Single room (carpet): ~45-60 mins, starting at $80
  • Two rooms + hallway: ~90 mins, starting at $150
  • Whole house (3+ bedrooms): ~3 hours, starting at $280
  • Upholstery: per item, starting at $50 (sofa) to $90 (large sectional)
  • Stairs: additional charge depending on number
  • Scotchgard protection: additional $30-$60 based on area

services.title: Post-Construction Cleaning
services.description:
Service Description

Specialized cleanup after renovations, remodels, or new construction, designed to remove the heavy dust, debris, and protective materials left behind by contractors. This is not a standard cleaning—it requires industrial equipment, protective gear, and a systematic approach to handle fine construction dust that settles into every crevice.

I start by removing large debris and packaging materials, then use HEPA-filter vacuums, air scrubbers, and damp wiping to capture and eliminate fine dust from walls, ceilings, vents, light fixtures, and cabinetry. Every surface is cleaned multiple times to ensure the space is truly dust-free. Floors are swept, vacuumed, and mopped (or scrubbed) to remove paint splatters, adhesive residue, and grout haze. I also clean windows that may have been covered in film or dust, and I polish fixtures and hardware to remove smudges.

I work with builders and homeowners to coordinate timing—ideally after all trades have finished but before furniture or final inspections. Safety is a priority: I wear appropriate PPE and dispose of waste responsibly. I can handle sites from small bathroom renovations to whole-house remodels.

What's Included

  • Removal of large debris, packaging, and protective coverings
  • HEPA vacuuming of all surfaces—walls, floors, ceilings, cabinets, vents
  • Dusting and wiping of all horizontal and vertical surfaces
  • Window and glass cleaning (construction film removed)
  • Floor cleaning: sweeping, vacuuming, mopping (and light scrubbing for tough residue)
  • Light fixture and ceiling fan cleaning
  • Baseboard and trim cleaning
  • Trash haul-away (within scope)

Pricing & Duration

  • Small renovation (1 room or bathroom): ~4-6 hours, starting at $250
  • Medium renovation (2-3 rooms): ~6-8 hours, starting at $400
  • Whole house (new construction): ~8-12 hours, starting at $700
  • Commercial spaces: custom quote
  • Disposal fees: included if within reasonable volume
  • Weekend/holiday availability at a premium

services.title: Leak Repair & Pipe Fitting
services.description:
Service Description

Fast, dependable repairs for leaking pipes, dripping faucets, low water pressure, and hidden moisture issues. I don't just patch symptoms—I diagnose the root cause using professional tools and techniques, ensuring a lasting solution rather than a temporary fix. I bring a wide range of fittings, washers, and replacement parts to resolve most issues on the first visit, and I pressure-test the repaired section to confirm system integrity before leaving.

For hidden leaks behind walls or under floors, I use acoustic listening devices and thermal imaging cameras to locate the source with minimal invasive investigation. This means I can often fix the problem with a targeted repair instead of ripping out large sections of drywall or tile. I also check for secondary damage like mold or rot and provide recommendations to avoid future problems.

I work on all common pipe materials—copper, PEX, PVC, and galvanized steel—and I provide clear, jargon-free explanations of the issue, the repair approach, and any preventive maintenance tips. Emergency call-outs available outside regular hours for urgent situations.

What's Included

  • Leak detection and diagnostic assessment
  • Faucet and fixture repair (dripping taps, cartridge replacement)
  • Pipe repair (soldering, compression, or push-fit depending on material)
  • Pressure testing of repaired section
  • Visual inspection for secondary damage
  • Advice on preventive maintenance

Pricing & Duration

  • Service call fee (diagnostic): $80 (waived if you proceed with repair)
  • Simple faucet repair: ~1 hour, $120-$180
  • Pipe leak repair (accessible): ~1-2 hours, $200-$350
  • Hidden leak (behind wall/floor): ~2-4 hours, $350-$600
  • Emergency call-out: additional $100 + standard rates
  • All parts and materials included in quote

services.title: Bathroom Plumbing Installation
services.description:
Service Description

Complete installation of sinks, toilets, showers, bathtubs, and water heaters for new bathrooms, remodels, or replacements. I handle every aspect of the plumbing—from rough-in installation behind the walls to final fixture fitting, ensuring all work meets local building codes and passes inspections.

For new construction or major remodels, I coordinate with your general contractor or other trades (electricians, tilers) to sequence the work properly. For replacements, I remove the old unit, upgrade or reconfigure plumbing connections as needed, and install the new fixture with proper seals and supports. I ensure correct venting and drainage to prevent future odors, clogs, or water damage. After installation, I pressure-test all connections, check for leaks, and verify proper operation of every fixture.

I also provide valuable guidance on fixture selection—helping you choose designs that fit your space, budget, and water efficiency goals. I can recommend brands and models based on durability and ease of maintenance. Whether you're replacing a worn-out vanity or building a dream spa bathroom, I bring the skills to bring it to life safely and beautifully.

What's Included

  • Removal and disposal of old fixtures (if applicable)
  • Rough-in plumbing preparation (new builds or remodels)
  • Installation of sinks, faucets, and vanities
  • Toilet installation with wax ring and seals
  • Shower and bathtub installation with mixing valves
  • Water heater installation (tank or tankless)
  • Pressure testing and leak-check of all connections
  • Clean-up and debris removal

Pricing & Duration

  • Sink/vanity replacement: ~2 hours, starting at $200
  • Toilet replacement: ~1.5 hours, starting at $150
  • Shower/bathtub installation: ~4-6 hours, starting at $500
  • Water heater replacement: ~3-4 hours, starting at $400
  • Full bathroom remodel plumbing: custom quote (typically $1,200-$3,000 depending scope)
  • Includes permit coordination if required

services.title: Drain Unclogging & Cleaning
services.description:
Service Description

Quick, effective removal of clogs from sinks, showers, tubs, toilets, and floor drains using professional-grade tools and techniques. I identify whether the blockage is local (near the fixture) or deeper in the main sewer line, and choose the appropriate method: mechanical snaking, hydro-jetting, or eco-friendly enzyme treatments for slow drains that need gentle clearing.

For stubborn or recurring clogs, I use a motorized drain auger (snake) that reaches 25-50 feet into pipes, breaking up hair, grease, soap scum, and debris. For severe blockages, I use hydro-jetting—high-pressure water that scours the pipe walls clean and clears even tree root intrusions. I never use harsh chemical cleaners that can damage your pipes; instead, I recommend safe enzyme treatments for ongoing maintenance to keep drains clear.

I also inspect drains with a camera when needed to diagnose recurring issues, and I provide clear advice on preventing future blockages, such as using drain screens, avoiding grease disposal, and scheduling regular maintenance. Emergency service available for severe backups.

What's Included

  • Diagnosis of clog location and severity
  • Mechanical snaking for local clogs
  • Hydro-jetting for deep or stubborn blockages
  • Camera inspection (if needed for recurring issues)
  • Recommendations for preventive maintenance
  • Clean-up of the work area

Pricing & Duration

  • Local sink/shower drain clog: ~30-60 mins, starting at $100
  • Toilet clog: ~30 mins, starting at $90
  • Main line clog: ~1-2 hours, starting at $250 (snaking) or $350 (hydro-jetting)
  • Camera inspection: $150 add-on
  • Emergency call-out: additional $100
  • Preventive maintenance packages available

services.title: Water Heater Repair & Installation
services.description:
Service Description

I repair failing water heaters or replace them with new, energy-efficient units—whether tank or tankless—to ensure your home has consistent hot water. I diagnose issues like faulty heating elements, failed thermostats, leaking tanks, and pilot light or burner problems on gas units, and I carry common replacement parts to fix most issues on the spot.

When replacement is needed, I help you choose the right size and type based on your household's hot water demand, energy efficiency goals, and fuel source (electric, gas, or hybrid). I install the new unit with proper safety features: expansion tanks, drip pans, T&P relief valves, and updated gas or electrical connections as required by code. I also install recirculation pumps if requested.

After installation or repair, I test the system thoroughly—checking temperature, pressure, and gas/electrical safety—and provide maintenance tips to extend the life of your unit. I dispose of the old unit responsibly and obtain permits if required.

What's Included

  • Diagnostic assessment of existing unit
  • Repair of heating elements, thermostats, valves, or burners
  • Replacement of old unit with new (tank or tankless)
  • Proper safety components (expansion tank, drip pan, relief valve)
  • Gas or electrical connection upgrades as needed
  • Pressure and temperature testing
  • Old unit removal and disposal
  • Permit coordination if required

Pricing & Duration

  • Repair visit: ~1-2 hours, starting at $150 (parts extra)
  • Standard tank replacement (40-50 gal): ~3-4 hours, starting at $450 (unit cost separate)
  • Tankless water heater installation: ~4-6 hours, starting at $600 (unit cost separate)
  • Includes up to 10 feet of plumbing/gas line work; additional charges for longer runs

services.title: Sewer Line Inspection & Repair
services.description:
Service Description

I use camera inspection to locate breaks, cracks, tree root intrusion, or collapses in your sewer line without digging. This non-invasive technique identifies the exact problem and its location so I can recommend the most effective and least disruptive repair method. I provide a video record of the inspection for your records and a clear, itemized recommendation.

Depending on the issue, I may recommend trenchless pipe lining (CIPP) for minor cracks and leaks, pipe bursting to replace the line with minimal excavation, or spot excavation if the damage is localized. For tree roots, I use hydro-jetting or mechanical cutting to clear them, then recommend root-absorbing treatments or lining to prevent recurrence.

Early detection and repair of sewer line issues can save you from catastrophic backups, property damage, and costly emergency repairs. I work with homeowners, property managers, and real estate agents for pre-purchase inspections.

What's Included

  • Camera inspection of the main sewer line
  • Video recording of the inspection
  • Diagnosis and repair recommendation
  • Trenchless repair (pipe lining or bursting) or traditional excavation
  • Clear debris removal
  • Restoration of landscaping (if excavation is needed)

Pricing & Duration

  • Camera inspection only: $250 (applied toward repair if you proceed)
  • Pipe lining (CIPP): starting at $1,500 depending length
  • Pipe bursting: starting at $2,500 depending length and access
  • Spot excavation repair: starting at $800 (localized damage)
  • Complete replacement: $3,000-$8,000 depending length and depth
  • Free detailed quote before any work

services.title: Gas Line Installation & Leak Detection
services.description:
Service Description

I safely install new gas lines for stoves, dryers, fireplaces, BBQ grills, and other gas appliances, and I detect and repair gas leaks quickly and thoroughly. I'm licensed and insured for gas work, and I follow strict safety protocols: every installation is pressure-tested, and I use electronic gas detectors to locate even the smallest leaks.

For new installations, I assess your appliance requirements, calculate correct pipe sizing, and run new black iron or CSST (flexible) gas lines from the meter to the appliance. I also install shut-off valves and connect appliances with proper flex connectors and fittings. When needed, I coordinate with the gas utility to adjust meter capacity or schedule inspections.

For leak detection, I inspect all accessible gas lines, connections, and appliance fittings using sensitive leak detectors and soapy water tests. Once located, I repair or replace the compromised section and re-test to confirm integrity. I prioritize safety and transparency, providing clear explanations of all work performed.

What's Included

  • Gas line sizing and design for new appliances
  • Installation of gas piping and shut-off valves
  • Appliance connection and testing
  • Gas leak detection (electronic and soap test)
  • Repair of gas leaks including fittings and pipe sections
  • Pressure testing to code standards
  • Clean-up and safety documentation

Pricing & Duration

  • Leak detection and simple repair: ~1-2 hours, starting at $180
  • New appliance gas line installation: ~2-4 hours, starting at $300 (excluding appliance)
  • Extended gas line runs: custom quote
  • Permit coordination: additional $50-$150
  • Emergency leak detection: additional $100 + standard rates

services.title: Sump Pump Repair & Replacement
services.description:
Service Description

I diagnose and fix failed sump pumps quickly to protect your basement from flooding, and I replace worn units with reliable, high-capacity systems designed for your specific water table and rainfall conditions. Common issues I handle include stuck float switches, jammed impellers, dead motors, clogged discharge lines, and faulty check valves.

When replacement is needed, I help you choose the right pump size (horsepower) and type—submersible or pedestal—and I recommend features like battery backup systems, secondary pumps, and water alarms to provide redundancy. I test the new pump thoroughly, including manual and automatic operation, and I clean the pit and discharge line to ensure optimal performance.

I also offer preventive maintenance visits to clean the pump, check connections, and test backup batteries before heavy rain seasons. A reliable sump pump is your best defense against basement flooding—I ensure yours is in top condition.

What's Included

  • Diagnostic assessment of existing pump
  • Float switch, impeller, or motor repair
  • Discharge line cleaning and inspection
  • Replacement with new pump (submersible or pedestal)
  • Installation of battery backup system (optional)
  • Testing of all operations
  • Clean-up of pit and surrounding area

Pricing & Duration

  • Repair (float switch, cleaning): ~1-2 hours, starting at $150
  • Replacement with standard pump: ~2-3 hours, starting at $350 (pump cost separate)
  • Replacement with battery backup system: ~3-4 hours, starting at $600 (system cost separate)
  • Preventive maintenance visit: $120

services.title: Toilet Repair & Installation
services.description:
Service Description

I handle all toilet issues—from persistent running and weak flushes to total replacement with a water-efficient model. I diagnose the specific problem: faulty fill valve, flapper leak, mineral buildup in siphon holes, or a wax ring failure, and I repair it on the spot with durable parts that prevent recurring issues.

For replacements, I remove the old toilet, inspect the flange (and replace if damaged), install a new wax ring with proper seals, and set the new bowl and tank securely. I shim and level the base to prevent rocking and ensure the wax seal stays intact, and I tighten connections carefully to avoid cracking porcelain. The installation includes connecting the water supply and testing for leaks and proper flushing.

I also offer water-saving upgrades: dual-flush conversion kits and low-flow models (1.28 GPF) that save water without sacrificing performance. I can advise on comfort height models for easier use and elongated vs. round bowls based on your space.

What's Included

  • Diagnosis of toilet issues
  • Repair of fill valve, flapper, or flush handle
  • Removal of old wax ring and seal replacement
  • Complete toilet replacement with new unit
  • Flange inspection and repair if needed
  • Shimming and leveling for stability
  • Leak testing and final adjustment

Pricing & Duration

  • Simple repair (fill valve/flapper): ~30-45 mins, starting at $100
  • Wax ring replacement (leaking base): ~1 hour, starting at $130
  • Full toilet replacement: ~1.5-2 hours, starting at $200 (toilet cost separate)
  • Water-saving conversion kit: +$50 for parts
  • Emergency after-hours: additional $100

services.title: Home Wiring & Rewiring
services.description:
Service Description

I provide safe, code-compliant electrical wiring for new builds and older homes that need modernization. Whether you're upgrading outdated knob-and-tube wiring, replacing aluminum wiring, or wiring a new addition from scratch, I ensure every circuit is properly sized, connected, and protected.

I perform a full panel assessment, balance loads to prevent overloads, and install GFCI (Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter) and AFCI (Arc Fault Circuit Interrupter) protection where required by current codes. I run new circuits for high-demand appliances, install dedicated lines for home offices or workshops, and ensure all connections are tight and secure using torque wrenches to manufacturer specs.

After wiring, I test every outlet, switch, and fixture to confirm correct polarity, grounding, and function. I also label your panel clearly so you know which breaker serves which area. All work is permitted and inspected where required.

What's Included

  • Full home or partial rewire
  • Installation of new circuits and subpanels
  • Upgrade of outdated wiring (knob-and-tube, aluminum)
  • GFCI/AFCI protection installation
  • Outlet, switch, and fixture replacement
  • Panel labeling and documentation
  • Permitting and inspection coordination

Pricing & Duration

  • Small rewiring (1 room): ~4-6 hours, starting at $500
  • Full home rewire (small house): ~2-3 days, starting at $3,000
  • Full home rewire (large house): ~4-5 days, starting at $6,000
  • Panel upgrade (100 to 200 amp): ~4 hours, starting at $1,200
  • New circuit installation: ~2-3 hours, starting at $250
  • Free on-site estimate before any work

services.title: Electrical Fault Finding
services.description:
Service Description

I quickly and accurately diagnose tripped breakers, flickering lights, dead outlets, power surges, and other electrical faults. Using professional tools—multimeters, circuit tracers, and thermal imaging cameras—I identify the exact cause of the problem before recommending any repair, so you're not paying for unnecessary work or guesswork.

Common issues I resolve include: overloaded circuits, loose connections at receptacles or panels, failing breakers, short circuits, open neutrals, and ground faults. I also check for dangerous conditions like overheating wires or backstabbed connections that increase fire risk. Once I find the root cause, I explain it in plain language and provide a written quote for the repair, which I can perform immediately or schedule for your convenience.

My goal is to give you peace of mind by fixing the issue correctly and safely, and I also provide tips to prevent similar problems in the future.

What's Included

  • Diagnostic assessment of electrical fault
  • Use of multimeters, circuit tracers, thermal cameras
  • Identification of root cause (not just symptoms)
  • Clear, jargon-free explanation of the issue
  • Written quote for repair (if not performed immediately)
  • Repair of the fault (if you proceed)
  • Testing and verification after repair

Pricing & Duration

  • Diagnostic visit: $80 (applied toward repair if you proceed)
  • Simple fault repair (loose connection, breaker reset): $100-$200
  • Circuit tracer/thermal imaging add-on: $50 (included in diagnostic)
  • Complex fault (intermittent, hard-to-find): $250-$400 depending time

services.title: Ceiling Fan Installation
services.description:
Service Description

I safely install ceiling fans to improve airflow, lighting, and style in your home. I replace existing light fixtures or ceiling boxes with fan-rated junction boxes, ensuring proper bracing and support for the weight and motion of the fan. I then assemble the fan, mount it securely, and wire it for correct operation—including wall switches, remote controls, or pull chains as you prefer.

Once installed, I balance the blades to eliminate wobbling and noise, and I test all speeds and light functions. I also hide wires neatly and ensure the canopy sits flush against the ceiling. For outdoor or damp locations, I install wet-rated fans with proper seals.

I can also install additional fans in rooms without existing wiring by running new cables from the panel (with your approval) for a clean, professional look.

What's Included

  • Inspection and preparation of the ceiling box
  • Installation of fan-rated junction box if not present
  • Mounting and wiring of the ceiling fan
  • Remote control or wall switch setup
  • Blade balancing for noise-free operation
  • Testing of all speeds and light functions
  • Clean-up and debris removal

Pricing & Duration

  • Fan replacement (existing box): ~1.5 hours, starting at $150
  • New installation (no existing box): ~2-3 hours, starting at $250
  • Remote control installation: +$30
  • Second-floor/extra tall ceiling: additional $50

services.title: Lighting Installation & Upgrade
services.description:
Service Description

I design and install a wide range of lighting to enhance your home's ambiance, function, and energy efficiency. I install recessed (can) lights, track lighting, pendant lights, under-cabinet kitchen lighting, landscape lighting, and outdoor security lights. I can also retrofit old fixtures with modern LED solutions, add dimmer switches, and install motion sensors or smart controls.

I start with a consultation to understand your needs: task lighting for kitchens and home offices, accent lighting for artwork or architectural features, or ambient lighting for living spaces. I calculate the correct number and placement of fixtures to avoid dark spots and glare, and I handle all wiring with clean, concealed runs. services.title: Dog Walking
